title: Crawl Cove crawl export
description: The full-crawl JSON export produced by the Crawl Cove desktop app's Reports page (one audit run, every crawled page). See ../docs/versioning.md for how schemaVersion changes.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this schema. Bumped on any added, renamed, or retyped field.

exportedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the export was written.

auditRunId.description: The audit run this export was generated from.

runIncomplete.description: True when the run had not finished crawling at export time — the page list may be a partial crawl.

finalUrl.description: The URL after following redirects, or null if not recorded.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code of the final response, or null if the request never got one (e.g. a fetch error).

depth.description: Crawl depth from the start URL (0 = start URL).

indexable.description: Derived: HTTP 200 and not noindex, by robots meta OR the X-Robots-Tag response header.

robotsMeta.description: Raw <meta name="robots"> content attribute, or null if absent.

xRobotsTag.description: Raw X-Robots-Tag response header, or null if absent — the other source of a noindex.

rendered.description: True if the page was fetched with a JS-rendering pass rather than the plain HTTP response.

redirectHops.description: Number of redirect hops the URL went through (0 = none).

fetchError.description: Network/fetch-level error (e.g. a timeout code), or null if the request completed.

schemaBlocks.description: Count of JSON-LD schema.org blocks found on the page.

contentFingerprint.description: 64-bit content fingerprint as a hex string, or an empty string when the page had too little content to fingerprint.

findingsCount.description: Number of SEO findings attributed to this page in the run.
